title: The glide path: de-risk as the goal approaches
objectives: Read the illustrative glide path and shift in stages, not all at once.
Check tax and exit loads before each move.
body_md:
As a goal gets closer, move gradually from equity to debt so a late market fall can't derail it. An illustrative path for a must-have goal: 10+ years left — 70–80% equity; 7 years — 60%; 5 years — 40%; 3 years — 20%; 1 year — 0–10%. Shift in stages (for example once or twice a year, often through an STP from equity to debt) rather than all at once, and check tax and exit loads before each move.

| Years left | Approx. equity share |
| --- | --- |
| 10+ | 70–80% |
| 7 | 60% |
| 5 | 40% |
| 3 | 20% |
| 1 | 0–10% |

> **Investor takeaway:** Review goals once a year and as they approach, not every time the market moves.
example: A goal 3 years away still 80% in equity: plan the shift now in stages through an STP, checking tax — not in panic after a fall.
say: Shift in stages, not all at once.
Check tax and exit loads before each move.
never: Hold 80% equity until the goal year.
Move everything to debt in one panic sale.
